content: That is correct. In Switzerland, if you wish to switch your basic health insurance provider (known as "Krankenversicherung" or KVG insurance), you must cancel your current policy in writing and ensure it is received by your current insurer by **December 31st** at the latest. Only then will the switch to the new insurer take effect as of January 1st of the new year. If the cancellation is received after this date, the switch will only take effect from the next calendar month after the cancellation is processed.
